name: EOS EVM
rootCause: The EOS Network Foundation tweeted that the EOS EVM has released version v0.4.2, which fixes a serious security vulnerability found in the EOS EVM. The EOS EVM contracts, EOS EVM nodes, and EOS EVM RPC components implemented by the EOS mainnet all need to be upgraded.
